findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hard-coded in plaintext within the Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived AWS credentials to anyone with read access to the Terraform state, source control, or the Lambda console/API. These credentials should be removed and replaced with an IAM role-based approach or a secrets manager reference.

The Lambda function does not configure a customer-managed KMS key (kms_key_arn) for encrypting environment variables, relying only on the default AWS-managed key, which provides weaker control over encryption of the embedded secrets.
The function uses nodejs12.x, a deprecated Node.js runtime no longer receiving security updates, increasing exposure to unpatched vulnerabilities.
